title: 第9章 帝血凤灵儿 我凤灵儿无需靠任何人也能证帝第10章 白清雪的选择
slug: 多子多福家族帮我攻略极品仙子
lines: 白天行似乎是被吓傻了，他哆哆嗦嗦地好一会才从第二个虚空戒里取出聘礼。
那是一个晶莹剔透的玉瓶。
玉瓶中，装着一滴金色的血液。
那滴血液只有指甲盖大小，却仿佛蕴含着一个世界，散发着一股至高无上，镇压万古的恐怖帝威！
这一次，连凤凰老祖都坐不住了，他失态地尖叫起来，声音都变了调。
“大帝的本命精血！难道是恒裕大帝的？”
“天呐！我没看错吧！这江家好大的手笔啊！”
“一滴帝血，若是运用妥当足以培养出一位14境准帝！”
“江家……江家竟然连这种东西都舍得拿出来当聘礼？！”
整个大殿，彻底炸开了锅！
所有太古王族的族长，呼吸都变得急促起来，眼睛瞪得血红，死死地盯着那滴帝血，恨不得立刻冲上去抢过来。
如果说准帝兵只是让他们震惊，那么这一滴大帝精血，已经让他们彻底疯狂了！
对于他们这些追求血脉之力的太古万族来说，一滴大帝精血的诱惑力，比两件准帝兵还要大！
说到底想要发挥出准帝兵全部威能的前提也得有准帝实力！
白天行拿着那滴帝血，感觉自己手上托着的不是一滴血，而是他白虎王族的希望！
诚然要把最有天赋的女儿嫁到江家，
可白虎王族又不是只有白清雪这么一位天骄，
退一万步说，即便不给族中后辈，便是他自己服用炼化，也足够他短时间内突破到13大圣境！
改变白虎王族目前的困境！
而第三枚虚空戒里是一枚丹药。
一枚散发着混沌气息，仿佛蕴含着大道至理的丹药。
白天行不认识这是什么丹药，但他能感觉到，这枚丹药的品阶，至少不逊色于准帝兵！
他不敢再拿出来了。
他怕自己再拿出来，会引起众怒，这些红了眼的王族会当场动手抢劫。
他连忙将神念收回，将储物戒指死死地攥在手里，
然后“噗通”一声，直接跪在地上。
他不是对着江战跪的而是对着江家的方向，遥遥叩拜。
“江家大恩，白虎一族，永世不忘！”
白天行激动得老泪纵横，声音哽咽。
他知道，从今天起，他们白虎一族的命运，将彻底改变！
江战满意地点了点头，他要的就是这个效果。
他目光扫过在场所有面带贪婪和嫉妒的王族族长，缓缓开口道：“这，只是我江家聘礼的一部分。”
“只要清雪神女嫁入我江家，她本人将享受我江家核心正【14位】准帝弟子待遇！”
“而白虎王族，将成为我江家的姻亲，受我江家庇护！从今往后，谁敢动白虎王族一根毫毛，就是与我江家为敌！”
这番话的言外之意就是，
谁敢打这些资源的主意就要考虑考虑自己能不能承受得住来自江家的怒火！
凤凰老祖的身体微微发软，有那么一瞬间很是后悔，
如果凤灵儿的态度没那么硬是不是就好了？
与底蕴残缺的白虎王族相比，
这滴大帝精血给他们，可是能极大概率培养出一位准帝的！
而那凤灵儿只不过是有可能成为准帝！
黄金狮族和神族的族长，对视一眼，眼神中看出懊恼。
草！
为什么我族没有神女啊！
content_en:
Bai Tianxing seemed to be frightened. He shivered for a while before taking out the betrothal gift from the second void ring.
It was a crystal clear jade bottle.
In the jade bottle, there is a drop of golden blood.
That drop of blood was only the size of a fingernail, but it seemed to contain a whole world, exuding a supreme and terrifying imperial power that suppressed the eternity!
"Emperor...Emperor's blood!!!"
This time, even Phoenix Ancestor couldn't sit still. He screamed out of control, and his voice changed its tone.
"The emperor's natal essence and blood! Is it from Emperor Hengyu?"
"Oh my god! Did I read that right? This Jiang family is so generous!"
"A drop of emperor's blood, if used properly, is enough to cultivate a 14th-level quasi-emperor!"
"The Jiang family...the Jiang family is even willing to give out such a thing as a betrothal gift?!"
The entire hall completely exploded!
All the patriarchs of the ancient royal clan were breathing rapidly, their eyes were bloodshot, staring at the drop of emperor's blood, wanting to rush forward and grab it immediately.
If the quasi-emperor soldiers only shocked them, then this drop of the emperor's essence and blood had already made them completely crazy!
For these ancient races who pursue the power of blood, the allure of a drop of the emperor's essence and blood is greater than two quasi-emperor weapons!
After all, if you want to unleash the full power of the quasi-emperor soldiers, you must have quasi-emperor strength!
Tian Tianxing held the drop of Emperor's blood and felt that what he was holding in his hand was not a drop of blood, but the hope of his White Tiger Royal Family!
It is true that the most talented daughter must be married to the Jiang family.
But the White Tiger Royal Family is not the only one with a genius like Bai Qingxue.
Taking a step back, even if he does not give it to the younger members of the clan, even if he takes the refining himself, it will be enough for him to break through to the 13th Great Saint Realm in a short time!
Change the current predicament of the White Tiger Royal Family!
And inside the third void ring is a pill.
An elixir that exudes the aura of chaos and seems to contain the ultimate truth.
Bai Tianxing didn't know what kind of elixir this was, but he could feel that the quality of this elixir was at least not inferior to that of a Quasi-Emperor Soldier!
He didn't dare to take it out again.
He was afraid that if he took it out again, it would arouse public outrage, and these red-eyed royals would rob it on the spot.
He quickly withdrew his spiritual thoughts and held the storage ring firmly in his hand.
Then with a "pop" sound, he knelt down directly on the ground.
He did not kneel in front of Jiang Zhan, but in the direction of the Jiang family, and knelt down from a distance.
"The Jiang family's great kindness will never be forgotten by the White Tiger clan!"
During the day trip, I was so excited that I burst into tears and my voice was choked with sobs.
He knew that from today on, the fate of their White Tiger clan would completely change!
Jiang Zhan nodded with satisfaction, this was the effect he wanted.
He glanced at all the greedy and jealous heads of the royal family present, and slowly said: "This is just part of the betrothal gift from my Jiang family."
"As long as Goddess Qingxue marries into my Jiang family, she will enjoy the treatment of being a core [14] quasi-emperor disciple of our Jiang family!"
"And the White Tiger Royal Family will become the in-laws of my Jiang family and will be protected by our Jiang Family! From now on, anyone who dares to touch a hair of the White Tiger Royal Family will be the enemy of our Jiang Family!"
The implication of these words is,
Anyone who dares to take advantage of these resources must consider whether he can withstand the anger from the Jiang family!
Ancestor Phoenix's body weakened slightly, and he regretted it for a moment.
Wouldn't it be nice if Feng Ling'er's attitude wasn't so tough?
Compared with the White Tiger royal family with incomplete heritage,
Give them this drop of the Emperor's essence and blood, and they can cultivate a quasi-Emperor with a high probability!
And that Feng Ling'er just has the possibility of becoming a quasi-emperor!
The heads of the Golden Lion Clan and the God Clan looked at each other with annoyance in their eyes.
Grass!
Why is there no goddess in our clan?
title_en: Chapter 9 Emperor Blood Feng Ling'er I, Feng Ling'er, can become emperor without relying on anyone Chapter 10 Bai Qingxue's choice
